newsitem.title: ITALY: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF MADONNA DI CAMPIGLIO SLALOM WINNER.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF MADONNA DI CAMPIGLIO SLALOM WINNER.

text.p: Profile of Thomas Sykora, who won the World Cup men's slalom at Madonna di Campiglio on Tuesday:
Previous victories: Three -- Kitzbuehel 1996, Lillehammer 1996, Park City 1996

Other facts: A tall, good-humoured skier who is known as the team entertainer. His aunt is Lise Prokopp, who was a pentathlon bronze medallist in the 1968 Olympics. Can look ungainly but style is certainly proving effective this season.
